title: Pip and Mama Bunny's Rainy-Day Fort

scenes.title: Pip and Mama Bunny's Rainy-Day Fort
scenes.subtitle: A Kids Story  •  Honey Bunny Kidz

lines.text: Honey Bunny Kidz presents: Pip and Mama Bunny's Rainy-Day Fort.
Pitter, patter, pitter, patter. It was a rainy day at Honey Bunny's cosy house.
Oh, rain, rain. I wanted to play in the park today.
Me too, Pip. What can we do inside?
Hmm. I have an idea. Shall we build a cosy blanket fort?
A fort? Yes, please! Woof, woof!
What do you think we need to build a fort?
We need two chairs, one big blanket, and lots of soft pillows!
Pip and I found the pillows. How many pillows can you count?
One, two, three, four! Four soft pillows!
What color is this pillow?
Pink! Pink like my bow.
And this one is blue, this one is yellow, and this one is green.
Mama Bunny held the chairs steady, and Honey and Pip spread the big purple blanket over the top.
Grown-ups help with the chairs, so everything stays safe.
Look! It's not just a fort. It looks like a ship!
A pillow ship! Mama made a sail from an old sheet, and a broom for the mast.
Mama folded a paper hat, too. Guess who wants to be the captain?
Me! Captain Pip, ready to sail!
Captain Pip piled all four pillows on his side of the ship.
Pip, may I have a pillow too? The floor is a little bit hard.
Hmm. But I like all the soft pillows.
What do you think Pip should do?
I know! I can share. One for you, one for me, and two for our friends!
Thank you, Pip! Sharing makes our ship cosy for everyone.
Knock, knock!
Who could that be? It's Dotty Duckling, with tiny raindrops on her feathers.
Quack! Hello, friends! It's too rainy to swim in the pond today.
Come aboard, Dotty! Here is a pillow for you.
Thank you, Captain Pip! What a lovely ship.
Everybody, row your arms with me! Can you row, row, row?
Row and row, here we go, over the waves so soft and slow!
Rock to the left, rock to the right, our pillow ship is snug and bright!
Oh! Here comes a pretend wave! Splish, splash!
I love the pretend sea! What sound does a duck make?
Quack, quack! You got it!
Let's make looking circles with our hands, like a spyglass. Can you look through yours?
I see, I see. Land ho! It's Sofa Island!
Hooray! Let's sail to Sofa Island!
Row, row, row! We're almost there!
Welcome to Sofa Island, sailors! I have apple slices for everyone.
Pip shared the apple slices, too. One for Honey, one for Dotty, one for Mama, and one for Pip.
Look out the window. The rain is getting softer and softer.
Let's take a big, slow ocean breath. Breathe in, like a wave coming in.
And breathe out, like a wave going out. Whoosh.
That was the best rainy day ever. Thank you for sharing the fort with me, friends!
On a rainy day, a blanket, some pillows, and friends who share can make a big adventure.
Share with a friend and subscribe to Honey Bunny Kidz!
Bye-bye, little sailors! See you next time on Honey Bunny Kidz.
